This recipe appears only at the private farms of Diego Garcia, and Savaii. Unlike what is listed, you need 50 Red Ore, not 30. The requirements for the recipe's appearance are:

Mine technology: 600
Facilities: Six (including at least one Red Ore producing mine plot)

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm
